title: Decoupling Planning and Control for Instructable Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.26788v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent work shows that pre-trained, instruction-tuned vision-language models (VLMs) perform well at mapping from instructions and observations to high-level plans, but struggle to realize such plans as reliable low-latency action sequences in unfamiliar environments. At the same time, world-model controllers excel at fast observation-to-action control, but lack open-ended task guidance. In this work, we combine these strengths into a single system, Instruct-to-Act, where we train a world-model controller to act autonomously at high frequency when conditioned on sparse, higher-latency, and high-level text instructions generated by a VLM planner. To train controllers to be language-instructable, we relabel segments of controller policy rollouts with synthetic instructions and jointly optimize a behavior-cloning objective along with existing reward-maximizing and world-modeling objectives. translated_title: 可指导代理的规划与控制解耦
translated_abstract: 近期研究表明，预训练的、指令调优的视觉语言模型（VLMs）在将指令和观察映射为高级计划方面表现良好，但在陌生环境中难以将这些计划实现为可靠的低延迟动作序列。与此同时，世界模型控制器擅长快速的观察到动作控制，但缺乏开放式任务指导。在本工作中，我们将这些优势结合到一个单一系统中，名为Instruct-to-Act，我们训练一个世界模型控制器，在由VLM规划器生成的稀疏、高延迟且高级文本指令条件下，以高频率自主行动。为了训练控制器使其可接受语言指令，我们用合成指令重新标记控制器策略回放片段，并联合优化行为克隆目标以及现有的奖励最大化和世界建模目标。我们在七个实体上评估了我们提出的方法。
tldr: 本文提出Instruct-to-Act系统，通过将VLM规划器生成的高层文本指令与世界模型控制器的低延迟动作执行解耦，并利用合成指令重标记和联合优化训练，使控制器能够接受语言指导，从而在陌生环境中实现可靠且高效的自主行动。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Instruct-to-Act system, which decouples high-level text instructions from a VLM planner and low-latency action execution from a world-model controller, and trains the controller to be language-instructable via synthetic instruction relabeling and joint optimization, enabling reliable autonomous behavior in unfamiliar environments.
